label: TenHands OSS Contribution
description: EXAMPLE activation payload TenHands would POST to /task/api/boards/{id}/activate-automation. hadoku-task stores no pipeline knowledge — no jobs, no routing, no retry policy. A lane is four fields. `editableBy: user` renders left and you drag tasks in and out; `editableBy: agent` renders right, is written only while holding a claim token, and becomes draggable again if a claim expires so work is never stranded. Lane names and the user/agent split are TenHands' to choose.
